_comment: Buildout-powered sites. `hash` is the plugin token from the site's Buildout embed (grep the page for token:"<40 hex>"; data endpoint is buildout.com/plugins/{hash}/inventory). One BuildoutAdapter per entry. Tokens below were extracted from each site's embed; Mid-America + TSCG confirmed live against the API. Buildout IP-rate-limits bursts, so validate one at a time. Optional per-site tuning: extra_retail / exclude_retail (subtype names).
_not_buildout: expcommercial = Next.js (own API); newmark = Algolia (app 5EP10X9C13, searchKey b9135619f78bf538f0142a17544f0c64); daum = server-side embed, no client token. These need their own adapters, not Buildout.
